mapper.select: SELECT v.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, r.name AS reviewer_name FROM user_verifications v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users r ON v.reviewer_id = r.id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, r.name AS reviewer_name FROM user_verifications v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users r ON v.reviewer_id = r.id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT v.*, u.name AS user_name, u.student_id AS user_student_id, r.name AS reviewer_name FROM user_verifications v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users r ON v.reviewer_id = r.id ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_verifications (user_id, type, real_name, student_id, image_urls, status, reviewer_id, reject_reason, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{realName}, #{studentId}, #{imageUrls}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{rejectReason}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_verifications SET type = #{type}, real_name = #{realName}, student_id = #{studentId}, image_urls = #{imageUrls}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
